about: Which levels of government may set each law amount the engine tracks. A local body also needs its state's grant where the state law says so (checked separately for the minimum wage, income tax and sales tax). Read by draftBill: a bill a body has no power to pass is blocked with the law's reason.

minimum-wage.source: 29 U.S.C. § 206 (federal floor); 29 U.S.C. § 218 (states and places may set higher)

income-tax.source: U.S. Const. amend. XVI; state constitutions; local income taxes only where state law authorizes them

sales-tax.source: No federal sales tax; local sales taxes only where state law authorizes them

property-tax.source: Property taxes are levied by local governments under state law (U.S. Const. art. I, § 9 bars an unapportioned federal direct tax)

snap-maximum.source: 7 U.S.C. § 2017 (allotments set federally from the Thrifty Food Plan)

unemployment-weekly-maximum.source: State unemployment insurance law under 26 U.S.C. § 3304

unemployment-insurance.source: State unemployment insurance law under 26 U.S.C. § 3304
